⚽ Defensive transition — working the reflex

🎯 OBJECTIVE
Develop transition reflex, reaction speed and explosiveness.

Setup:
15 × 15 m area with a mini-goal on each side.

Action:
An attacker starts facing a defender with the goal of dribbling and scoring. As soon as they score or lose the ball, a new attacker immediately enters play.

The former attacker (in yellow) switches roles and becomes defender, reacting as fast as possible to stop their new opponent (the blue) from scoring.

Key objective:
React very quickly after the end of the attacking action to switch to defending.

Scoring:
→ 1 point per goal scored
→ 2 points if the defender wins the ball back

Volume:
4 to 5 reps per player in each role.

🔧 VARIATIONS
Limit the action time or play 2 vs 2.

🎓 COACH TIPS
Aim for high intensity.

📐 Pitch : 15 × 15 m
👥 12-16 players
🧰 Equipment : Cones, Mini-goals
⏱️ Duration : 8 min

⚽ Transition work — reactivity and quick transitions

🎯 OBJECTIVE
Develop transition speed (fast attack and pressing), communication and collective solidarity.

Setup:
2 mini-goals on the sides + 1 big goal with goalkeeper.

Game progression:
→ Starts with 2 vs 1 (2 reds vs 1 blue). The reds attack the mini-goals, the blue attacks the big goal.
→ When the action ends, 2 blues enter → 3 vs 2 attacking the big goal.
→ Then 2 reds join → 4 vs 3.

Rules:
→ The team in possession has 10 seconds to score.
→ Focus: immediate reactivity to ball loss or recovery.

Duration:
Each phase lasts 1 to 2 minutes before launching a new sequence.

🎓 COACH TIPS
Look for high concentration.

📐 Pitch : 40 × 30 m
👥 12-16 players
🧰 Equipment : Cones, Mini-goals
⏱️ Duration : 12 min

Each player stands on a cone, spaced about 10 metres apart, facing away from the direction of running.

Action:
On the coach's signal, player 1 starts and sprints in a straight line at maximum speed. The others keep their backs turned.

As soon as player 1 overtakes another player, that player immediately sprints to try to catch them. The same principle repeats with each player.

Minimum 1 minute between 2 reps. On each rep players switch cones.

⚽ Speed in 2 vs 1 or 2 vs 3

🎯 OBJECTIVE
Develop maximum speed and counter-attack.

Setup:
3 defenders (1 on the goal line + 2 on the halfway line on the sides) and 2 attackers starting from the halfway line.

Action:
The 2 attackers must run very fast to end up in a 2 vs 1: the defender starting from the centre shouldn't be able to catch them.

If the attackers don't run fast enough, they'll end up in a 2 vs 3 — the 2 defenders from the centre will have had time to recover to the same line to defend.

Rules:
→ No tackling allowed for the 2 defenders from the centre
→ They can only defend once they have overtaken the attackers
→ Maximum 10 seconds to score

Volume:
3-4 reps in each role per player.

Recovery:
Minimum 1 minute between 2 reps.

🎓 COACH TIPS
Aim for high intensity.

👥 6-16 players

⚽ Reaction speed — hoops

🎯 OBJECTIVE
Work on reaction speed and explosive movements in a fun and competitive format.

Setup:
Each player inside a hoop in a zone. Poles of different colours around the hoops.

Before each start, the coach removes a hoop: there will always be one player without a spot.

Action:
On the coach's signal a colour is called. Players must:
→ Leave their hoop
→ Go round the pole of the corresponding colour
→ Return as fast as possible to one of the remaining hoops

Rules:
→ The player without a hoop is eliminated
→ The exercise repeats with one hoop fewer each round

Recovery:
Minimum 45 seconds between 2 reps.

Eliminated players can stay active: 3 to 4 sprints of 20 m with full recovery (30 seconds minimum).

5 circuits with the ball linked one after another.

→ Circuit 5: Acceleration and dribble at each pole.

Laps run without pause for 15 min at a moderate pace.
